text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Racun (Pindaan Jadual

Ketiga) 2019.

Pindaan Jadual Ketiga

2. Jadual Ketiga kepada Akta Racun 1952 dipinda dalam perenggan 1 dengan

menggantikan butiran "Diazepam and other substances structurally derivated

from 1,4-benzodiazepine except flumazenil, flunitrazepam, nimetazepam and

pirenzepine" dengan butiran berikut:

"Diazepam and other substances structurally derivated

from 1,4-benzodiazepine except flumazenil and pirenzepine".

Dibuat 29 Mac 2019

[KKM.R.600-1/1/56;PN(PU2)172/XII]

DATUK SERI DR. DZULKEFLY BIN AHMAD

 Menteri Kesihatan

POISONS ACT 1952

POISONS(AMENDMENT OF THIRD SCHEDULE) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 30(2) of the

Poisons Act 1952 [Act 366], the Minister, after consultation with the Poisons Board,

makes the following order:
